chunks: I asked Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the word of God, Mighty and Majestic:
And thus We made you a middle nation so that you may be witnesses over the people [2:143]
He said: 'We are the middle nation, and we are the witnesses of God over His creation and His proofs on His earth.'
I said: 'the word of God, Mighty and Majestic: the religion of your father Ibrahim [22:78].'
He said: 'He meant us specifically. He named you all Muslims from before in the books that have passed and in this Quran, so that the Messenger may be a witness over you.'

Thus the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) is the witness over us with what he conveyed to us from God, Mighty and Majestic, and we are the witnesses over the people. So whoever ratifies the truth, we shall ratify him on the Day of Resurrection, and whoever denies the truth, we shall belie him on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْأُمَّةُ الْوُسْطَى: The 'middle nation' — the Imams as intermediary witnesses between God and creation
key_terms.حُجَجُهُ: His proofs/authorities — the Imams as God's appointed proofs on earth
key_terms.شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ: Witnesses of God — the Imams who testify for or against people on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.مِلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: The religion of Ibrahim — the prophetic tradition the Ahl al-Bayt are the truest inheritors of

ai.seo_question: What does 'middle nation' (umma wasat) in Quran 2:143 mean according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Burayid al-'Ijli asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the Quranic verse 2:143 which describes a 'middle nation' as witnesses over mankind. The Imam declares that this verse refers specifically to the Imams (Ahl al-Bayt), who serve as God's witnesses and proofs on earth. He further explains that the reference to the 'religion of your father Ibrahim' in 22:78 also refers to the Imams, establishing a chain of testimony: the Prophet witnesses over the Imams, and the Imams witness over people, with eschatological consequences on the Day of Judgment.
